title: Linear-size logarithmic-depth Boolean circuits for multiselection

standard_prerequisites.name: AKS sorting networks
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Ajtai, Komlos and Szemeredi [1], source Lemma8, exact invoked statement retained

standard_prerequisites.name: Pippenger self-routing superconcentrator
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Pippenger [25], source Theorem18, complete routing interface and author circuit simulation retained

standard_prerequisites.name: Parallel prefix for associative operations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Ladner and Fischer [20], exact invoked statement retained in Lemma26 proof

core_obligations: Build depth-efficient sorting by telescoping input/output bit-position paths.
Implement unordered multiselection using self-routing superconcentrators and convert to ordered selection by inner joins.
Pack binary inputs into large-alphabet blocks and derive the final size/depth bound.
difficulty_reason: The author combines a non-routine telescoping path-length argument for sorting, self-routing superconcentrator simulation, circuit inner joins and alphabet packing to obtain near-linear selection circuits.

dedup.scope: Own DOI and actual ECCC identity searched in full legacy/prepared snapshots without hit. One author Main Theorem counted; sorting, routing, inner-join and packing support remain uncounted.
